Lingrove Basic voice: English and Mandarin speech on your device

Engine: eSpeak NG 1.52.0.1, GPL-3.0-or-later.
Source: https://github.com/echogarden-project/espeak-ng
Pinned commit: 9a550bef455f03b459f51796e3482833aab7fbc0

This application ships a build from that exact source, using Emscripten 4.0.21.
Only English and Mandarin language data is selected; original upstream source
files are not modified. The original copyright and license notices are retained.

The complete corresponding source, dependency source, build script, exact
compiler image identifier and notices are available on this same site:

/vendor/speech/speech-source.tar.gz
/vendor/speech/REBUILD.md
/vendor/speech/build-speech.sh
/vendor/speech/COPYING
/vendor/speech/COPYING.BSD2
/vendor/speech/provenance.json

The source archive is approximately 24 MB. It is a source-code download, not
required to listen. The playback runtime and English/Mandarin data together
are approximately 3.1 MB and are downloaded when Basic voice is first used.
